description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, V MEMO); Close. Then 5 session(s), each adding one row through a table recordset (AddNew, ID, V, Update) and closing: IDs 1-5 with V a Memo of U+20AC characters (2 bytes each, not compressible): 2, 50, 64, 66 and 98 bytes. Pages 42-53 are read after the create session and after each insert session, and FieldSize read back at the end. Asks where each value is placed (inline in the row, a single LVAL row, chained pages) and which page it takes.
retentionNote: r-q19-growth-open (zfrp stretch 4 open growth cases): designed probe, one element varied; answers kept with their page bytes
